主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on January 17, 2018. The filing includes three exhibits: 99.1, 99.2, and 99.3. Exhibit 99.1 is a Third Supplemental Indenture dated January 17, 2018, among Brookfield Finance Inc., Brookfield Asset Management Inc., and Computershare Trust Company of Canada. Exhibit 99.2 is a Supplemental Indenture to the Second Supplemental Indenture dated January 17, 2018, among the same parties. Exhibit 99.3 is a Consent of Torys LLP dated January 17, 2018. The filing is related to the Registration Statement of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. and Brookfield Finance Inc. on Form F-10 (File Nos. 333-220746 and 333-220746-01). The report was signed by A.J. Silber, Vice President, Legal Affairs and Corporate Secretary of Brookfield Asset Management Inc., on January 17, 2018.
